refnamediv.refpurpose: Receives data from a socket whether or not it is connection-oriented

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.parameters;
socket
The socket must be a Socket instance previously created by socket_create().
data
The data received will be fetched to the variable specified with data.
length
Up to length bytes will be fetched from remote host.
flags
The value of flags can be any combination of the following flags, joined with the binary OR (|) operator.
Possible values for flags
Flag Description
MSG_OOB
Process out-of-band data.
MSG_PEEK
Receive data from the beginning of the receive queue without removing it from the queue.
MSG_WAITALL
Block until length bytes are received. However, if a signal is caught, the remote host disconnects or a timeout expires, the function may return less data.
MSG_DONTWAIT
With this flag set, the function returns even if it would normally have blocked.
address
If the socket is of the type AF_UNIX type, address is the path to the file. Else, for unconnected sockets, address is the IP address of the remote host. If the socket is connection-oriented, it is "0.0.0.0" ("::" for AF_INET6), or an empty string for an AF_UNIX socket.
port
This argument only applies to AF_INET and AF_INET6 sockets, and specifies the remote port from which the data is received. It is required for these sockets, and can be omitted for an AF_UNIX socket, which leaves it unchanged. If the socket is connection-oriented, port will be 0.
